title: Chapter 430 - 430 Shock; Cooperation! (2)
content:
Chapter 430 - 430 Shock; Cooperation! (2)

Chapter 430 - 430 Shock; Cooperation! (2)

430 Shock; Cooperation! (2)

Lin Fan said, “It should be. Is there a problem?”

“No problem, no problem!” Feng Zhixiang hurriedly said. “A while ago, we just approved a few plots of land for Dahua Group. Now, it seems that those plots of land aren’t enough. Later, I’ll report to the higher-ups and give Dahua some approval.”

The two of them continued to chat for a while before Feng Zhixiang left with a smile on his face.

Lin Fan sat on the sofa and casually scrolled through his phone.

After a while, he muttered, “Studying gaming helmets? Looks like I have to make a few more game helmets as soon as possible…”

Thinking of this, Lin Fan dialed the number of the CEO of Dahua Group, Ran Fei.

…

At this moment, in the chairman’s office of Dahua Group.

Ran Fei sat in front of the computer and flipped through the documents seriously.

After a long while, he sighed and said, “The carbon-based chip technology has already reached an absolute leading level. However, the market has not accepted it at all.

“The cost of carbon-based chips isn’t high, but it’s still a little higher than silicon-based chips.

“And silicon-based chips are already enough for daily needs…

“What should we do?

“If only there were some functions that require carbon-based chips, but it’s too difficult!”

Ran Fei sighed again.

The carbon-based chips were good, but no one cared about them.

It had to be said that this was indeed a very uncomfortable matter.

At this moment, there was a dull knock on the door.

A man wearing golden glasses rushed in with a document in his hand.

“Director Liu, what’s the matter?” Ran Fei asked.

Director Liu said excitedly, “Nature! The latest issue of Nature published a thesis titled Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets!”

“Gaming helmets?” Ran Fei was puzzled. “Dahua Group isn’t involved in the gaming industry.”

He came from a technical background and only wanted to lead the company in researching and developing technology.

Therefore, even when Ran Fei had enough manpower and financial resources, he never considered getting involved in extremely profitable fields such as games, real estate, cars, and other industries.

The company had stuck with the same general direction over the years. Ran Fei felt that Director Liu, who had been with him for many years, should know.

Director Liu said, “This gaming helmet is different. According to the thesis, it can bring a person’s consciousness into the gaming world!

“In addition, the gaming helmet requires an ultra-high-performance chip to operate!”

As soon as he said this, Ran Fei immediately understood what the game helmet meant.

Considering this gaming helmet could make a person’s consciousness enter the game world, it would definitely make people go crazy. This gaming helmet would become popular all over the world!

Would it not mean that carbon-based chips could be put to good use?

This was good news!

This was definitely great news!

Ran Fei was about to laugh excitedly…

At this moment, the phone on the table rang.

Originally, Ran Fei wanted to reject it.

He only had the gaming helmet in his mind.

He wanted to hear more about the gaming helmet.

However, when he saw that the caller ID was Lin Fan, he could not help but press the answer button.

After all, Lin Fan was the biggest shareholder of the Dahua Group.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. May I know why you’re calling?”

Ran Fei was someone who did not like to beat about the bush.

Moreover, his entire heart was focused on the gaming helmet.

Therefore, he went straight to the point.

Lin Fan said, “Oh, I invented a gaming helmet, and I wanted to ask if you wanted to collaborate to produce it.”

When Ran Fei heard this, he was stunned.

His mouth was half-open, and he was completely motionless.

Lin Fan invented a gaming helmet?

The person who Director Liu just mentioned was Lin Fan? He was the one who wrote the thesis on gaming helmets?

That was right!

Lin Fan was in the computer field, biology field, and physics field… He was definitely a big shot!

In this world, who else could compare to Lin Fan… This time, he invented a piece of high-tech equipment that could allow one’s consciousness to enter the game world.

Why did Ran Fei not think of it earlier?

Lin Fan saw that no one answered and continued, “Chairman Ran, are you not interested in this? If so…?”

Ran Fei did not wait for Lin Fan to finish and quickly said, “I’m interested, I’m interested! I’m coming to Jiangbei now!”

After hanging up, Ran Fei called his secretary and said, “Help me book the earliest flight to Jiangbei!”

Then, he quickly packed his things and prepared to walk out.

“Huh? Director Liu, are you still here?”

Director Liu’s mouth twitched slightly. ‘I’ve always been here!’

However, he still said in a very gentle voice, “Yeah… Chairman Ran, do you have something urgent to deal with?”

“Yes!” Ran Fei thought about it and said, “Forget it. Come with me. We’ll go to Jiangbei and talk about a collaboration with Professor Lin Fan!”

Discuss a collaboration with Professor Lin Fan!

Meet Professor Lin Fan!

Director Liu’s heart raced.

He was a technician!

Lin Fan, who invented carbon-based photolithographic machines, super batteries, and other products, was his idol!

Now, he could see his idol!

It was as if he was making a pilgrimage!

How could his heart not beat faster?

Director Liu hurriedly said, “Alright!”

…

About three hours later, Ran Fei and Director Liu arrived in Jiangbei.

Ran Fei wanted to discuss the matter of the gaming helmet as soon as possible.

On the other hand, Director Liu wanted to see his idol as soon as possible!

Therefore, they did not take a break. As soon as they got off the plane, they headed straight for the Coiling Dragon Villa.

At this moment, Lin Fan was sipping on Spirit Tea.

He heard the doorbell ring and slowly opened the door.

“Mr. Lin, we finally meet again,” Ran Fei greeted him with a smile.

“This is Liu Dazhi, the technical director of our Dahua Group.”

Liu Dazhi quickly said in a somewhat nervous tone, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Liu Dazhi was 42 years old and was the technical director of Dahua Group.

He had seen many important figures and attended many high-level meetings.

At this moment, facing a young man who was only in his 20s, he was actually nervous!

If outsiders knew about this, who knew what kind of expression they would have?

However, Lin Fan did not mind it too much. He nodded his head calmly and said, “Come in.”

When the two of them walked in, they were immediately attracted by the fragrance of Spirit Tea.

It was a refreshing smell.

Seeing the two of them staring at the Spirit Tea, Lin Fan could not help but say, “You guys should be thirsty, right? Sit down and have a cup of tea.”

He also knew that Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi had specially rushed over from Peng City. Giving them some tea was also the right way to treat guests.

Following that, Lin Fan poured two cups of Spirit Tea and placed them in front of them.

The refreshing fragrance became even stronger, causing Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi to instinctively pick up the teacups and pour the contents into their mouths.

As soon as the Spirit Tea entered their mouths, their bodies and souls seemed to be cleansed in an instant.

They had spent more than three hours rushing from Peng City to Jiangbei, yet their fatigue had completely disappeared at this moment.

What replaced it was an unprecedented sense of ease and freedom!

Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi were both intoxicated by the tea and could not extricate themselves.

At this moment, Lin Fan asked, “Do you want to take a look at the gaming helmet?”

When Ran Fei heard Lin Fan’s words, he finally reacted and stuttered, “Ah… Alright, alright.”

Even though he responded like this, his eyes could not help but look at the Spirit Tea in front of him.

Lin Fan said, “If you want more, then pour it yourself.”

Ran Fei waved his hand and said, “No, no. Let’s look at the game helmet first.”

What if Lin Fan thought that he was just enjoying himself and did not care about the gaming helmet?

Lin Fan did not think too much about it and said, “Alright, the gaming helmet is inside.”

As he spoke, he got up and walked toward the bedroom.

As for Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi, who obviously wanted to continue drinking Spirit Tea, Lin Fan left them be.

Earlier, he had personally poured them a cup of Spirit Tea.

If they wanted to continue drinking it, they should pour some themselves!

Of course, he could not pour tea for them all the time.
